name: vellum-rehearsal-design-ir-observer-gpu
description: Vellum mirror build of the design-IR observer (pulp-import-design + pulp-design-ir-observe). DRY-RUN: built from the X-export rehearsal mirror (receipt 20261010-4ddc60a0b6), not a published mirror; receipts produced with it are dry-run evidence only. The instrument sources are Pulp's; every closure-named unit archive linked into them is Vellum's mirror build (link-map census in provenance.json). GPU variant: adds the observe-gpu step (Skia Graphite on Dawn via the mirror's gpu-device and render-2d archives, render receipt, loader image list) for gpu-raster, gpu-receipt and provider-census.

roots.checkout: Vellum dry-run checkout the mirror archives were built from (dry-run/v-adapters-20261011)
roots.build: Vellum CMake build directory holding the rehearsal archives
roots.export_receipt: X-export receipt naming the Pulp origin of the mirror (H3-F9)

probes.name: provider
argv: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print('\n'.join(sorted({a for t in d['tools'] for a in t['kept_archives'] if 'skia' in a or 'dawn' in a})))" '{root:observers}/provenance.json'; echo 'renderers: ScreenshotBackend::skia (CPU raster) and Skia Graphite on Dawn (gpu-render.png); view-core/canvas/render-2d/gpu-device from the Vellum mirror archives'; otool -L '{tool:observer}' | tail -n +2 | sed 's/ (.*//'

probes.name: fonts
argv: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print('\n'.join(sorted({a for t in d['tools'] for a in t['kept_archives'] if 'bundled-fonts' in a})))" '{root:observers}/provenance.json' | while read a; do shasum -a 256 "$a"; done
